title: Cleanout Accessibility for Main Drainage Lines
description: Proper placement and accessibility of drainage cleanouts are vital for long-term plumbing maintenance. Installing cleanouts at significant directional changes, at the base of vertical stacks, and near building exits allows service technicians to clear blockages efficiently. A cleanout must always have sufficient clearance in front of the threaded cap so drain cleaning equipment can be safely positioned and operated. Neglecting cleanout access during rough-in often leads to costly structural removal when a main sewer line eventually backs up. Always verify clearance distances with applicable local plumbing codes.
